test_inference: test the open_clip ViT-B-32-quickgelu model inference with image and text encoding
create_model_and_transforms: create an open_clip model and preprocessing transforms using create_model_and_transforms with a pretrained checkpoint
encode_image: encode an image into feature vectors using the open_clip model encode_image method
encode_text: encode text tokens into feature vectors using the open_clip model encode_text method
tokenize: tokenize a list of text strings using the open_clip tokenizer for CLIP model input
